Fixed a bug with Pearl of Tsoatha which caused Fresh Meat to be twice as likely to appear as any other support gem option. This may result in some existing Pearls of Tsoatha with Fresh Meat support having the support effect they grant changed.
Fixed a bug where Roiling Tempest was not applying to secondary Lightning Damage such as from the Inpulsa's Broken Heart Unique Body Armour's Lightning Explosions.
Fixed a bug where Hexpass Support did not prevent enemies from dealing Critical Strikes if the Curse was applied with Blasphemy Support.
Fixed a bug where Kinetic Blast of Clustering on Mercenaries had much lower base secondary radius than intended.

Fixed a bug where some meta-crafted Modifiers and the Cannot roll Caster Modifiers Implicit on Wands were not being respected by the Crafting Bench options to reroll 1 or 3 random Modifiers on a Rare item.
Fixed a bug where Maps influenced by the Originator's Memories could not spawn Sentinels.
Fixed a bug where the Bestiary craft to add a Modifier to a Rare Map was not usable on Maps.
Fixed a bug where Harvest Bosses were spawning all Monsters and Volatiles on top of each other during add phases.
Fixed some bonus drops from Monsters, such as Talismans on Red Beasts, being unintentionally converted to other items where the Monster had Rare Monster Modifiers.
Fixed a bug where Aukuna and Hyrri were granting twice as much progress to Enshrouded items in the Domain of Timeless Conflict compared to the other Legion Generals.
Fixed a bug where the Ghorr's Magnificence Demonic Power caused the player to take more Damage instead of less.
Fixed a bug where Wand-wielding Mercenaries would have their Wands disabled if they didn't have anything equipped in their offhand.
Fixed a bug introduced in 3.27.0 where Gigantic Rogue Exiles were splitting on death once, instead of twice.
Fixed a bug where Boss-specific Uniques dropped by Velka, the Tide Witch, could be converted to other items by area modifiers.
Fixed a bug that prevented Arakaali from using her cleave attack.
Fixed some rare cases where Monsters trapped in Essences could still move and/or use skills.
Fixed a bug where Spells cast by Crab Totems from the Crustacean's Call Unique Staff were being created at an incorrect height.
Fixed a bug with Rolling Magma and very high reduced projectile speed.
Fixed a bug which caused escape route minimap icons in Heist Blueprints not to reveal until you were very close.

Fixed a bug where allocated non-Keystone Passive Skills on the Passive Skill Tree through the Thread of Hope Unique Jewel would prevent you from unsocketing the Foulborn Intuitive Leap Unique Jewel if the allocated node overlapped both Jewels.
Fixed a bug where Divination Card related modifiers could roll on Shaped Regions in Ruthless.
Fixed a bug where Cluster Jewels socketed between the Templar and Marauder areas of the Passive Skill Tree could be slightly misaligned.

Fixed a bug when viewing advanced modifier descriptions on Breach Rings and Wands that cannot roll caster modifiers, where it would display "1% increased" next to modifiers that cannot roll normally on these items (such as special Essence modifiers).
Fixed a bug where Reap and Fleshrend were not factoring in area damage modifiers to Physical Damage dealt per second on the skill's tooltips (this was purely a display issue).
Fixed a bug where the Heroic Tragedy Unique Timeless Jewel had an incorrect Currency Exchange gold fee.
Fixed a bug where Incursion Map chests in Ruthless were using the wrong effects.
Fixed a bug where Storm Call of Trarthus did not display its Physical Damage dealt per second on its skill tooltip.
Fixed a visual bug where the Incursion progress bar could escape its bounding box.
Fixed a bug where the Trigger Summon Phantasm Skill when you consume a Corpse Runesmithing Enchant was displaying an incorrect level. This is purely a description change.
Fixed a bug where the Trigger Stance Swap when you Attack with Perforate or Lacerate Crucible Modifier was displaying an incorrect level. This is purely a description change.
Fixed a display issue with Pearl of Tsoatha's "Skills Socketed in your X are supported by ..." not indicating that particular portion of the Modifier is rollable.
Fixed a display issue with a number of stats which previously did not describe their range of values.
Fixed a bug where the Bound by Flame Divination Card did not display as "Corrupted" on the Divination Card.
Fixed a bug where some hidden slots in the Fragment Stash Tab could still display a highlight if you had an item on your cursor and were hovering that item slot.
Fixed an issue where the text colours on the Saresh, Velka and Abyssal Bloodline selection UI did not match the rest of the Bloodline's art.
Fixed a bug where navigating the Cosmetics Panel could be slow when using a controller if you own a lot of microtransactions.
Fixed an issue where Zana's Ingenuity was not required for completion in the Unique Stash Tab in Standard leagues.
Fixed a bug where Berserk Buff had an outdated description.
Fixed a visual bug where the Blightborn Bow and Quiver microtransaction could glow.
Fixed a bug where decorations from The Sovereign Hideout were missing 2D art.
Fixed an issue where items with modifiers would display incorrect prefixes when playing in Russian, Portuguese, German, Spanish, French.
Fixed an issue where UI related to listing items for trade would not detect currency formatting based on the players language setting.
Fixed an issue where the Lighting Rods in the Temple of Atzoatl were very loud.
Fixed a bug where Auras and Minions were not correctly resuming after you finished flying in the Plateau of the Gods Hideout.
Fixed a bug where the sound of the Ascendant Portal microtransaction was too loud.
Fixed a bug where the Transcendence Portal Effect microtransaction could flicker on PlayStation.

Fixed a bug where audio was not playing for the Ashbringer Wyvern Shapeshift Effect, Archon of Ash Rhoa Pet, Precursor Remnant Level-up Extra Effect, and Nightfowl Dodge Roll Effect microtransactions.
Fixed a wonky interaction between the Silverbranch Unique Bow and the Chains of the Incarcerator Weapon Effect microtransaction.
